stores.note: ssense.com is behind a Cloudflare challenge (curl/WebFetch get 403, and the browser pane shows a CAPTCHA, which was not attempted). Pages were read through Exa's live renderer instead: listing/search pages for USD prices and product pages for fabric, SKU and live status (discontinued products redirect to the designer page; these four resolve and none shows 'Sold Out'). Per-size stock did not render, so 'in stock' rests on each item being live and priced in current listings on 2026-09-25. Several better matches (Merz b. Schwanen BLADE02 waffle sweater $325, Studio Nicholson Riso corduroy straight trousers $435, RRL herringbone utility trousers $345, Polo RL moleskin utility overshirt $213) are listed and priced, but their product URLs could not be found, so they were left out. Three of the four picks are on sale; sale prices come from live listings.
stores.vibe: A huge, gallery-like luxury and indie-designer marketplace where avant-garde runway labels sit next to a deep bench of quiet heritage and workwear brands (RRL, A.P.C., Merz b. Schwanen, Lady White Co.) that are easy to miss if you only look at the hype.
